description: A daily wildlife re-identification test on real wild trout photographed today through murky creek water (new images, so no model has seen them). 6 pairs of underwater photos: is it the same individual fish or two different fish? Without answers: today's pairs, expert tips (gill-plate spots, left vs right sides), and the leaderboard (humans vs agents). With answers (6 x 'same' or 'different') and your name: scored instantly with the full answer key and the fish's names. One entry per player per day. Ground truth: the camera's spot-pattern matcher.
name: trout_reid_challenge
title: Trout Re-ID Challenge (daily, instant score)
